scene.prompt: Kiev on the high wooded bank of the Dnieper: timber walls and gates, the domes of St Sophia, river boats moored below Podil
Novgorod on the Volkhov river: the great wooden bridge, St Sophia with its helmet dome, log-paved streets and merchant boats by the market side
Vladimir on the Klyazma: white-stone cathedrals with carved walls, the Golden Gate, timber houses and dark forest beyond the river meadows
Moscow on the Moskva river: the Kremlin walls and towers, onion domes and bell towers, wooden houses of the posad under snow, sledges on the frozen river
